findings.note: Herro's ESPN page lists him as a Bucks guard with game-time-decision (GTD) status and a foot issue. It also shows a career average of 4.1 assists in 32.5 minutes, which is above the 3.5 line, though the exact date of the GTD tag isn't shown.

Herro's NBA.com profile says he is out with a foot injury for a Friday game against the Wizards. The note isn't clearly dated, so his availability for this Portland game is still uncertain and should be checked.

The Bucks traded Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami for Herro and young players, so Herro moves into a post-Giannis Milwaukee team. That likely gives him a bigger on-ball creator role, which works against an assists Under.

Boozer is listed as Active and has started all 14 games at about 31 minutes. He shot 7-13 from three (29 points) at Washington on 11/16, but he made no threes against Toronto on 11/9 or Brooklyn on 11/14, so his recent 3PM swings widely. His season 3P% is 32.2.
In the first meeting with Golden State on Oct. 23, Boozer went 4-7 from three in 37 minutes, scoring 25 points with 13 rebounds. That is well over the 1.5 line against this opponent.

The Nov. 4 Rookie Ladder ranked Boozer No. 1 and listed him at 36.4% from three, including a 4-for-5 triple-double against Portland. It shows he is a featured, volume-shooting rookie, and I found no injury or role-reduction reports.
